# Every script in this repository

**Generated by `scripts/inventory.py`. Do not edit by hand.**
Each line is the script's own first docstring line or first comment,
so a summary that reads badly here is a summary to fix at the source.

Before writing a script, look for it here. If something close exists,
extend it with an option that defaults to today's behaviour rather
than adding a second script beside it -- see CLAUDE.md, "One script
per job, and it lives in the repo".

351 scripts.

## Start here

| job | script |
|---|---|
| train and score, monochromatic, whole chain | `scripts/mono/cannon/run_all.sh` |
| train and score, polychromatic, whole chain | `scripts/poly/cannon/run_all.sh` |
| train one arm: `CONFIG=... sbatch` | `scripts/poly/train.slurm` |
| predict, careless, stats, phenix, peaks | `scripts/poly/run_pipeline.py` |
| the same, as one batch job | `scripts/poly/pipeline.slurm` |
| predict, DIALS, phenix, peaks | `scripts/mono/cannon/03_pipeline.sh` |
| laue-dials on one sweep | `scripts/poly/laue_process.sh` |
| score one PDZ2 arm end to end | `scripts/poly/pdz2/arm_pdz2.sbatch` |
| cluster to laptop, every table | `scripts/figures/pull_figdata.sh` |
| draw every figure, rebuild the gallery | `scripts/figures/render_all.sh` |
| write docs/tables/ | `scripts/figures/make_tables.py` |
| this list | `scripts/inventory.py` |
